name: Edna
source:
Oliver's demon pet whom he summosed as a child using the head of a dead homeless woman called Edna. She often reminisces her past as a human.

He summoned her and therefore, she obeys him. Although she often prefers to be brutal and violent.

[spoiler]Kristian steals Edna from Oliver to keep an eye on him.[/spoiler]
